function.name: search_recipes
function.description: Match a dish name or cuisine word to a recipe_id in the six-card corpus. Returns id, title, base servings and dietary tags. Does not return ingredient rows, method steps, nutrition, or swaps.

query.description: Dish name or cuisine keyword, e.g. 'paneer butter masala'.

function.name: scale_recipe
function.description: Multiply every ingredient quantity on one recipe from its base servings to a target serving count. Returns the scaled ingredient table and the original method steps. Does not search the corpus, does not inspect allergens, does not swap.
